:::{#exr-held-out-unbiased}
#### Held-out predictions and the generalization error

A [prediction rule](#def-prediction-rule) $\fitted$
is fitted to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$.
A [held-out set](#def-held-out-set) of $\nheld$ observations
$(\heldpredvar{1}, \heldoutvar{1}), \ldots, (\heldpredvar{\nheld}, \heldoutvar{\nheld})$
is drawn from the same population as the new observation $(\newpredvar, \newoutvar)$
of @def-generalization-error,
each independently of $\trainset$.
Write $\obsloss{*,\ifold}$ for the [loss](#def-observation-loss) of $\fitted$ on held-out observation $\ifold$.

Find, given $\trainset$,
the expected mean loss of the held-out predictions,
in terms of the generalization error $\generr_{\trainset}$:

$$
\E{\avgto{\ifold}{\nheld} \obsloss{*,\ifold} \mid \trainset}.
$$

:::
